title: site-redirects
description: Retired public URL -> successor mapping. Locale prefixes are derived, never written here.

from.description: Retired unprefixed route path. No locale prefix, no fragment.

to.description: Successor unprefixed route path, optionally with #fragment (verified against the en document).

toZh.description: Optional zh successor when the translated heading id differs (verified against the zh document). Absent means the locale-expanded `to`.
